parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — the canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Merging these would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app demonstration semantics. The duplication is intentional: the WallpaperSampleApp needs its own local copy of DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init for self-contained demonstration purposes.
